notes.title: PARANOIA PLACE - FULL RELEASE
notes.notes:
PARANOIA PLACE is officially out of Early Access! This update contains the last major set of changes as we go into our full v1.0 launch:

• Co-op UP to 3 Players
• Complete rebalanced all game difficulties
• Two big multi-level maps (Chapters)
• Increased replayability
• Major Loot spawn rebalancing
• Major game optimization
• Proximity voice chat
• Killer can hear your mic (Optional)
• Added localization into 13 languages
• Complete reworked audio system
• Added controller support
• Added dynamic MAP
• Dropped items now appear in MAP view
• Flashlight now infinite
• Flashlight flickers when killer spawn nearby
• Improved killer behavior (depending on the selected game difficulty)
• Exit demonic hands now need time to burn out after completing the ritual
• Fixed collision glitches on low specs PC's
• Overseer wall creature AI fixes
• Orphan creature AI improved
• New achievements (28 in total)
• Many, many, many other minor fixes

We put everything we've wanted into v1.0 of PARANOIA PLACE! Like we said before, after our game launches we'll be monitoring this launch closely to ensure it's as problem-free as possible for all players, deploying patches as needed to address any issues. Once we're sure things are in a good spot, our small team will be taking a break to recharge, and plan what's next. Looking further ahead to Q3 2025 and beyond, we'll be excited to say more about what's in store for us just as soon as we're ready. To keep us in touch, join our [url=https://discord.gg/aEQveWNzxf]DISCORD[/url]!

Thank You!!!

notes.title: PARANOIA PLACE v.1.0 goes live on 9th April!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Your feedback, your patience and support have been invaluable, shaping PARANOIA PLACE into the game it is today.

We believe that time has come! PARANOIA PLACE is ready to go full release on 9th April!
As many of you already know many of our plans have been disrupted by the horrific and unjust war that russia started against our country, Ukraine. The russian aggression persists, and we still have a great deal of work ahead to support our people and our families during this challenging time.
After leaving Early Access we'll be monitoring this launch closely to ensure it's as problem-free as possible for all players, deploying patches as needed to address any issues. Once we're sure things are in a good spot, our small team will be taking a break to recharge, and plan what's next.
If you want to help us to reach more players, spread the word and leave a review, it's can be the best additional support you can give to us. And one more thing we plan to launch a before release sale that will offer a big discount!

After that discount, we’ll increase the price a bit to 6.99 $/€
Thank you everyone who has supported us so far!

Kind Regards,
BLOODY PIXEL GAMES

notes.title: Our Next Map: New Info!
notes.notes:
New mechanics, new terrifying events and much more are on the way. Global changes will also affect the first chapter - The Asylum.
We know many of you have been waiting for some information on our next map - so here it is! 

[h3]The Orphanage[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40524281/17ef558d9952241ca22b39f689d507c7eee4ef28.png[/img]

On the outskirts of the small town of Raven Hills, an old orphanage was nestled among the whispering woods. The orphanage was a mere facade, a breeding ground for indoctrination and nightmarish ceremonies, where the veil of innocence was slowly but surely lifted, revealing the unsettling dark truth lurking on it. In this place a mysterious cult wielded its influence, orchestrating the lives of the innocent within.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40524281/ecacb77141b83b2dd134cc37809a4b762b171d2b.png[/img]

Each new chapter will be connected, the story of each killer will complement the overall picture of what is happening in this corrupted small town.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40524281/f85f87758ac6ca917625a933aa7d2ccbf705e0ad.png[/img]

[h3]Release Day[/h3]

At this time we do not have a specific release date for the new map, but it will likely be the first quarter of 2024. We know this might feel like a long wait, but as a small indie studio located in Ukraine we do our best to put out new quality content as quickly as we can. 

We really appreciate your support and understanding!

• Additional game optimization

notes.title: PARANOIA PLACE is Available NOW!
notes.notes:
Dear friends! Last year was very difficult not only for our small team, but also for our country - Ukraine. There may still be those who will say that games should be out of politics, but it's hard not to talk about it when you have russian missiles flying over your head. Many of us were forced to leave our homes, all because of russia's insidious attack on Ukraine on February 24, 2022. For almost a year now, we have been living under constant shelling, interruptions in electricity and communications have become commonplace, despite all this, we continue to work and help each other. Many projects that we planned to make in 2022 had to be frozen and we began to outsource and collaborate with other developers. Today we are finally release Paranoia Place in early access, we really hope that this project will catch your attention, and give us the opportunity to continue doing what we love so much. Despite the impossibility of predicting the near future, we look at the world with hope and faith in the victory of our country, our people and the entire civilized world over tyranny. We have big plans and hopes for the development of this project, and we are also looking forward to expanding our team and getting back to work on our other announced and unannounced games. We are waiting for your feedback, reactions and emotions. Thanks to everyone who has been supporting us all this time, peace to all and Glory to Ukraine!
